# Input Component

### Input

**Exports:**
- `Input` - Text input component
- `SearchInput` - Search-specific input component

**Input Props:**
- `name`: string | undefined
- `value`: string (bindable, default: '')
- `label`: string | undefined
- `error`: string | undefined - Error message to display
- `size`: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' (default: 'medium')
- `prefix`: string | Component | undefined - Prefix content (text or icon)
- `prefixStyling`: boolean (default: true) - Apply styling to prefix
- `suffix`: string | Component | undefined - Suffix content (text or icon)
- `suffixStyling`: boolean (default: true) - Apply styling to suffix
- `rounded`: boolean (default: false) - Use a fully rounded input shape
- `spellcheck`: boolean | undefined
- `placeholder`: string | undefined
- `disabled`: boolean (default: false)
- Extends `HTMLInputAttributes`

**SearchInput Props:**
- Accepts the same input props as `Input`, except `prefix`, `suffix`, `type`, and `value` are managed internally.
- `value`: string (bindable, default: '')
- Pressing `Escape` clears the current value.

**Usage:**
```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import { Input } from 'kampsy-ui';

	let small = $state('');
	let defaultInput = $state('');
	let large = $state('');
</script>

<div class="w-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-x-4">
	<Input bind:value={small} placeholder="small" size="small" />
	<Input bind:value={defaultInput} placeholder="default" />
	<Input bind:value={large} placeholder="large" size="large" />
</div>

<Input prefix="https://" suffix=".com" bind:value placeholder="default" />
<Input prefix="ui/" bind:value placeholder="default" />
<Input prefix="www." rounded suffix=".com" placeholder="Label example" />
<Input
	prefix="www."
	prefixStyling={false}
	rounded
	suffix=".com"
	suffixStyling={false}
	placeholder="Label example"
/>

<Input label="Project Name" bind:value placeholder="my-awesome-project" />
<SearchInput bind:value placeholder="Search projects" />

<!-- Press Escape to clear the SearchInput value. -->
```

## Installation

```bash
pnpm i -D kampsy-ui@latest
```

## Documentation

Visit http://ui.kampsy.xyz/input for full documentation and examples.
